Global Tables and Cross-Region Restore

remediation.change: Replace the global table with a single-Region table: AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable becomes AWS::DynamoDB::Table (CDK TableV2 becomes Table, awscc_dynamodb_global_table becomes aws_dynamodb_table) and aws_dynamodb_table_replica resources are removed. Carry the keys, indexes, stream, TTL and encryption settings over, and set the billing mode explicitly.
remediation.consequence: The new resource type replaces the table, so an existing table's data must be migrated. CDK Table defaults to provisioned capacity, TableV2 to on-demand.

remediation.change: Remove the replica blocks from the table.
remediation.consequence: Writes are no longer replicated to other Regions.

remediation.consequence: No copies of the secret exist in other Regions.
